title: Witch's Twilight Offering
description: A woman with long flowing red hair in a white dress stands in a lavender field at sunset, holding a small wreath in one hand while the other rests on a large black mound topped with a crown and surrounded by scattered golden rings and bones. In the background, a horned figure with a staff stands near the water as butterflies float in the colorful sky.
prompt: A beautiful young woman with long flowing red hair wearing a white dress stands in a vast field of purple lavender at sunset. She holds a small wreath in her raised hand and touches a large black mound topped with a golden crown. Scattered around the mound are golden rings and white bones. In the background, a horned cloaked figure holds a staff by the water's edge. Butterflies float in the warm orange and pink sky with glowing orbs. Mystical fantasy scene, detailed digital painting.
